e5.H1: median over 32 post neurons entropy at b11 minus b00
e5.H3: (MLP carry/(carry+mlp) b11 minus b00) minus (attention identity/(identity+attention) b11 minus b00)
e5.H4: normalized_zero mean four-block Spearman(path head mass,abs effect) minus mean four-block Spearman(abs activation_gradient,abs effect)
e5.missing: each required term must be finite; H1 permits finite unit medians with explicit unit counts
e5.tests: two-sided sign tests, Holm four within checkpoint

e4.total_features: 196 patch absolute mass normalized to sum1
e4.structure_features: 4 blocks x (Q,K,V,identity,attention,carry,mlp_branch) x 196 normalized patch mass; concatenate total features
e4.zero_mass_feature: all zero vector, an explicit absence of input dependence; feature standardizer zero std replaced by1
e4.shuffle: per image and per block, independent fixed permutation of seven labels, same permutation algorithm in each checkpoint; total retained
e4.target: mean over 4 blocks of mean absolute normalized_zero complete head effects
e4.fit: fit train standardized features and centered unscaled target, primal if dimension small else dual solve, validation MAE picks lambda; no refit on validation
e4.test: paired absolute error total minus structure and shuffled minus structure, plus Spearman
e4.pair: all E5 test image pairs, lower 10th percentile total-distribution JS distance including threshold ties, report seven-edge mean JS and effect difference, no outcome filtering

e1.visual_matching: raw cropped RGB 8x8 area-pooling descriptor, deterministic nearest different class from E1; relation computed independently from output arrays
e1.pairs: for each image all4 same-class peers, nearest different class and hash-min random different class; average similarities over finite same units, then per image, then per class
e1.activation: eta squared of class labels on activation, descriptive per unit; paired class-level abs activation similarity normalized by each unit global SD
e1.main: same class JS similarity minus matched different class JS similarity, median class difference, 8 tests per model Holm

e3.rank: within layer and candidate family Spearman of absolute single replacement effects for each output (gt,high,random,margin); signed effect stored separately
e3.capture: effect magnitude of method top1 / max candidate absolute single effect
e3.regret: max candidate absolute single effect minus selected absolute single effect
e3.main_comparison: path minus activation_gradient paired at image level, report each layer/ref/k, Holm within model/family/output; signed margin topk comparison and capture/rank are separate families
e3.random: average20 repeats within image before image bootstrap
e3.matching: disjoint nearest log activation in same candidate set, no replacement; impossible equal budget becomes NA
e3.selectivity: target endpoint selected sets compared with high and random non-target endpoint sets at each fixed budget; gt/high/random logits and dynamic margin both signed and absolute
